namespace Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection {
    using global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions;
    using global::ValidationModules;
    using global::ValidationModules.Naming;

    /// <summary>Registers every validator this assembly generated.</summary>
    public static class GeneratorTestsValidationExtensions {

        /// <summary>
        /// Adds this assembly's generated validators, and a validation runner for each
        /// validated type.
        /// </summary>
        /// <remarks>
        /// <b>Not idempotent.</b> Calling this twice registers every validator twice, and a
        /// runner merges every registered validator for a type - so each error would be
        /// reported twice. Add rather than TryAdd is deliberate: registering a second
        /// validator for one type is how a hand-written rule composes with the generated
        /// one, so this cannot dedupe without breaking that.
        /// </remarks>
        public static IServiceCollection AddGeneratorTestsValidators(this IServiceCollection services) {
            services.AddSingleton<IValidatorFor<global::Sample.Pet>, global::Sample.PetValidator>();

            services.AddValidationRunner<global::Sample.Pet>();

            // TryAdd, so a namer the consumer registered first survives. The policy here is
            // the one the literals above were emitted with, so the engines that resolve a
            // namer at run time agree with the generated code by default.
            services.TryAddSingleton<IValidationFieldNamer>(CamelCaseFieldNamer.Instance);

            return services;
        }
    }
}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using ValidationModules;

namespace Sample;

public sealed partial class PetValidator : IValidatorFor<global::Sample.Pet> {

    public PetValidator() { }

    private static readonly Regex SkuPattern0 = new Regex("^[A-Z]{3}$");

    public ValidationFlow Validate(ref ValidationContext ctx, global::Sample.Pet value) {
        var missingName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.Name);
        if (missingName && ctx.ReportRequired("name").ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if (!missingName && (value.Name is not null && (value.Name.Length < 1 || value.Name.Length > 100)) && ctx.ReportStringLength("name", 1, 100).ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if ((value.Age < 0 || value.Age > 30) && ctx.ReportRange("age", 0, 30).ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if (value.Sku is not null && !SkuPattern0.IsMatch(value.Sku) && ctx.ReportPattern("sku").ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if (value.Status is not null && (value.Status != "available" && value.Status != "pending" && value.Status != "sold") && ctx.ReportAllowedValues("status", "available, pending, sold").ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if (value.Tags is not null && (value.Tags.Count < 1 || value.Tags.Count > 10) && ctx.ReportItemCount("tags", 1, 10).ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if ((value.Quantity % 5 != 0) && ctx.ReportMultipleOf("quantity", 5).ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if ((value.Price % 0.05m != 0) && ctx.ReportMultipleOf("price", 0.05m).ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if (!global::ValidationModules.ConstraintChecks.IsMultipleOf(value.Ratio, 0.01m) && ctx.ReportMultipleOf("ratio", 0.01m).ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if (value.Codes is not null && !global::ValidationModules.ConstraintChecks.AllUnique(value.Codes) && ctx.ReportUniqueItems("codes").ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if ((value.AtLeastOne < 1) && ctx.ReportRangeAtLeast("atLeastOne", 1).ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;
        if ((value.AtMostNinetyNine > 99) && ctx.ReportRangeAtMost("atMostNinetyNine", 99).ShouldStop) return ValidationFlow.Stop;

        return ValidationFlow.Continue;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The same tests as <see cref="Validate"/>, returning at the first failure and building
    /// no path, message or error record - a caller wanting only a boolean pays for nothing else.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsValid(global::Sample.Pet value) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.Name)) return false;
        if (value.Name is not null && (value.Name.Length < 1 || value.Name.Length > 100)) return false;
        if ((value.Age < 0 || value.Age > 30)) return false;
        if (value.Sku is not null && !SkuPattern0.IsMatch(value.Sku)) return false;
        if (value.Status is not null && (value.Status != "available" && value.Status != "pending" && value.Status != "sold")) return false;
        if (value.Tags is not null && (value.Tags.Count < 1 || value.Tags.Count > 10)) return false;
        if ((value.Quantity % 5 != 0)) return false;
        if ((value.Price % 0.05m != 0)) return false;
        if (!global::ValidationModules.ConstraintChecks.IsMultipleOf(value.Ratio, 0.01m)) return false;
        if (value.Codes is not null && !global::ValidationModules.ConstraintChecks.AllUnique(value.Codes)) return false;
        if ((value.AtLeastOne < 1)) return false;
        if ((value.AtMostNinetyNine > 99)) return false;
        return true;
    }
